description: The geometric hood on display inside the shop builds a classic Hidden Mickey out of its own pattern. It sits near the upper right corner, away from the center of the design where the eye lands first.

whereToLook.scene: The custom hoods on display inside the shop, the geometric one
whereToLook.exactSpot: Upper right corner of the hood. The three-circle shape is built from the geometry.

bestTip: Skip the center of the design and go straight to the corner.
